title: Timothy Bradstreet
description: "There is so much conflict in the STAR WARS universe," offers Tim Bradstreet, "that it isn't surprising that bounty hunters abound. They come in all shapes and sizes...and are always sinister-looking." Bradstreet, a veteran illustrator of role playing games and comics, began his career in 1986 at age 18. He has illustrated books for TSR, FASA, White Wolf and other gaming companies, for which he has received much critical acclaim. His comics credits include HARDLOOKS, X, ALIENS: MUSIC OF THE SPEARS (Dark Horse), Clive Barker's AGE Of DESIRE (Eclipse), HAWKWORLD (DC) and numerous covers for all the major publishers.
